integrity: The generator matrix is reconstructed directly from the public full text. Exact enumeration verifies the complete Hamming spectrum, Hermitian LCD property, all six-column independence tests, all seven-column circuit counts, and the dual weight-seven coefficient.
scientific_limitations: The computation is for the explicit quaternary Hermitian LCD \([22,10,9]\) representative printed in Example 2. It does not classify all codes with the same ordinary parameters or assert equivalence of their spectra.
title: Exact weight enumerator and dual distance of the new quaternary Hermitian LCD \([22,10,9]\) code
